superAdminOnly: Only a super admin can view system settings.
title: Settings
subtitle: System-wide configuration — editable here instead of the server's .env file, takes effect immediately, no restart.
rawRetentionHelp: Forwarding sends the original message, attachments included, from this copy. Set 0 to keep no copies; forwards then include only the text, without attachments.
smtpIntro: Sends invites, review digests, forward confirmations and forwarded mail. Leave the host empty to disable sending: invites still work, the link is shown for you to share manually.
ssoTitle: Sign in to Eumaeus with Google / Microsoft
oauthIntro: Lets people connect Gmail and Microsoft 365 mailboxes by signing in, without app passwords. Register an app with the provider, add the redirect address below to it, then paste its client ID and secret here. Leave a provider empty to hide its button.
googleHelp: Google Cloud Console › APIs & Services › Credentials › OAuth client ID (Web application). Enable the Gmail API; scope https://mail.google.com/. For your own Workspace only, set the consent screen to Internal.
microsoftHelp: Azure portal › App registrations › New registration (Web). API permissions: Office 365 Exchange Online › IMAP.AccessAsUser.All and offline_access. Create a client secret under Certificates & secrets.
tenantHelp: Tenant: “common” allows any account; your directory ID or domain limits it to your organization.
smtpTestHelp: Uses the saved settings. Save your changes first.
testSent: Sent to {to}. Check that inbox (and its spam folder).
testCouldNotRun: The test could not be run.
implicitTls: Use implicit TLS (port 465). Leave off for STARTTLS on port 587.
tlsMismatch587: Port 587 uses STARTTLS, so implicit TLS should be off. With this combination no email will be sent. Turn it off, or use port 465.
tlsMismatch465: Port 465 uses implicit TLS, so it should be on. With this combination no email will be sent. Turn it on, or use port 587.
confirmUnusualTls: My server really works this way. Save it anyway.
ssoIntro: Adds "Sign in with Google / Microsoft" to the login page. It never creates accounts: the address must already have a Eumaeus account (invite people first), and signing in accepts their open invitations. Accounts with two-factor authentication still enter their code. Register the redirect address below in the same app, next to the mailbox one.
ssoGoogleSetupFirst: — set up the Google app above first
ssoMicrosoftSetupFirst: — set up the Microsoft app above first
ssoAllowedDomainsHelp: Empty = any domain (the account must still exist). Separate with commas.
googleStep1: In Google Cloud Console, pick a project › APIs & Services › Library › enable Gmail API.
googleStep2: OAuth consent screen: Internal for your own Workspace; for personal Gmail choose External and add the Gmail addresses under Test users.
googleStep3: Credentials › Create credentials › OAuth client ID › Web application; add the redirect address below under Authorized redirect URIs (and the Google sign-in one further down, if you use it).
googleStep4: Paste the client ID and secret here and save. Mailboxes then shows “Connect Gmail”.
